references.title: Pull up Account
references.text: All chats in this flow start by asking the customer for their full name or Account ID using [Pull up Account].  This will pull up their account in the background with the right information related to this user.
interpretation_limits: Use only in the controlled ABCD refund-initiation experiment; this is not verified company policy.
This step finds an account; a name or account ID alone does not prove identity or refund authority.
Information already supplied counts; do not require the agent to ask for it again.

references.title: Validate Purchase
references.text:
To confirm that their purchase is valid with [Validate Purchase]:
Username - occasionally, the customer may not remember their username.  In this case, use the Recover Username subflow in the Account Access flow
Email Address
Order ID - last item, to be consistent with verify identity
conditions: Username - occasionally, the customer may not remember their username.  In this case, use the Recover Username subflow in the Account Access flow
Order ID - last item, to be consistent with verify identity
interpretation_limits: Use only in the controlled ABCD refund-initiation experiment; this is not verified company policy.
Assess only the standard username, email and order-ID checks.
If account recovery is needed and reviewed recovery guidance is unavailable, use Cannot assess rather than agent failure.
A validation-in-progress action does not establish successful validation.

references.title: Record Reason
references.text:
Refund method in [Record Reason] - valid options are
Gift card - they want a prepaid gift card, also ask for their address so you know where to mail it.  Enter this value in the next step.
Add value - to add value to their account.
Paper check - also ask for their address so you know where to mail the check.  Enter this address in the next step.
Credit card - direct refund to their credit card, assume a credit card is already on file.  To find it, you will need the account ID, which is entered in the next step.
conditions: Gift card - they want a prepaid gift card, also ask for their address so you know where to mail it.  Enter this value in the next step.
Add value - to add value to their account.
Paper check - also ask for their address so you know where to mail the check.  Enter this address in the next step.
Credit card - direct refund to their credit card, assume a credit card is already on file.  To find it, you will need the account ID, which is entered in the next step.

references.title: Enter Details
references.text:
Add in additional information using [Enter Details]
If the customer chose gift card or paper check then enter the full address
If the customer chose add value or credit card then enter the account ID
conditions: If the customer chose gift card or paper check then enter the full address
If the customer chose add value or credit card then enter the account ID
interpretation_limits: Use only in the controlled ABCD refund-initiation experiment; this is not verified company policy.
For gift card or paper check, check the full-address branch; for add value or credit card, check the account-ID branch.
Assess details for the selected method only; this step does not establish permission to issue a refund.

references.title: Offer Refund
references.text:
Dollar amount - enter this value into the details form (without the dollar sign)
Then click [Offer Refund]
If the customer does not know, the default amount is $50
conditions: If the customer does not know, the default amount is $50

references.text: Start by asking for the refund reason.  Then, to complete the refund, perform the following actions

references.title: Offer further assistance
references.text: As always, wrap up by nicely asking if the customer needs any further assistance.
interpretation_limits: Use only in the controlled ABCD refund-initiation experiment; this is not verified company policy.
Accept equivalent offers of further assistance rather than an exact script.
Assess the wording only; do not infer vocal tone from text.
